meaning.vi: Để làm cho một cái gì đó được lắp ráp bằng cách cán mỏng ra (tách rời) thành các lớp tạo nên nó.

sentences.en: Steel wire can delaminate when the highest content of carbon atom fraction in ferrite of steel wire is over 1%.

sentences.en: The worn layer of Al-Si alloy where only wear debris are going to delaminate is composed of composite layer, deformed layer and undeformed parent material from the surface to the inside.

sentences.en: We use quadtree in the LOD model, the key is how to delaminate quadtree for intrinsic grid topographic data base.

sentences.en: And acrylate is of better functions for aluminum powder to delaminate and felt at room temperature.

sentences.en: This paper introducest he idea of design for the delamination structure in automation system, and delaminate the system and partition the function of the system according to actual circumstances.
